value.name: writes father's name and timeline
value.description: Asha writes her father's name on a blank page and begins mapping visits across a column of years.
evidence: She wrote her father's name at the top of a blank page and then a column of years down the left margin, and tried to pin a visit to each one: the Thanksgiving with the snow, the spring she'd come down for an afternoon and left before dinner, the long gap she could not honestly bracket at either end.

value.name: marks gaps in visit history
value.description: She sees uneven stretches in the timeline and marks the missing periods with dashes.
evidence: The line of years filled in unevenly, with whole stretches she had to mark only with a dash, and she looked at those dashes for a moment before moving on.

value.name: receives Rosa's medication advice
value.description: Asha's phone buzzes with another message from Rosa advising her to check medication logs.
evidence: Her phone buzzed against her leg and she tilted it up in her lap; Rosa again, brief as always—"Check the medication logs too, those show changes faster than notes."

value.name: adds medication logs to request
value.description: Asha adds medication logs for the last thirty days to her pending records request and underlines the item.
evidence: She added a third item under the receptionist's pending list, *medication logs, 30 days*, and underlined it once before closing the notebook over her thumb.

value.name: returns to receptionist counter
value.description: Asha gets up from her seat and goes back to the counter with her notebook and bag.
evidence: When the receptionist looked up again, Asha was already on her feet, the notebook closed in one hand and the bag's strap looped over her wrist.
She crossed back to the counter

value.name: requests medication logs from receptionist
value.description: Asha calmly tells the receptionist she wants to add thirty days of medication logs to her request.
evidence: and said, in the same level voice she'd used before, that she wanted to add the medication logs to her request—thirty days, alongside the nursing notes and the discharge addendum.

value.name: receptionist repeats request and delays
value.description: The receptionist repeats the requested records and says the administrator is still on a call.
evidence: The receptionist tapped a key, repeated the three items back, and said the administrator was finishing a call.

value.name: waits for receptionist to remember
value.description: Asha lingers at the counter longer than necessary, wary that the clerk might forget her request.
evidence: Asha said that was fine and stayed at the counter a moment longer than she needed to, the way she sometimes did with a clerk who might forget.

value.name: receives another warning from Rosa
value.description: As Asha turns away, her phone buzzes again with Rosa telling her to watch for sudden changes.
